deep_analysis:
Flat book — 0/6 slots, zero exposure, so there are no trade-level steers this cycle; everything below is portfolio-level.

DEPLOYABILITY is the finding. signal_compactor wrote an EMPTY hot-set in 1237 of the last 1440 cycles (86%) over 24h, with only four deployable windows (22:57-23:21, 00:57-01:01, 01:23-01:27, 02:01-02:02); it has been empty continuously since 02:03 (18 min at write time). The decider answers each cycle with "No signals above 40% confidence — skipping execution" — six PENDING signals exist, none entered top-10 by compaction score, so 0/6 positions sit idle while the 5m aggregate prints LONG_BIAS 76/5/48. Nothing is losing; this is pure opportunity cost, and it is where the flat book comes from — not a market decision.

Both sides of the tape are gated at once, which is why nothing fills. Pipeline gates (blocked_signals.json 02:16-02:17): CONTINUUM-BLOCK denied BTC LONGs as "BTC bearish structure" through 01:26, then CONTINUUM-BULL began denying SHORTs as "BTC bullish structure (CALM+LEAN_BULL+AT)" from 02:16 — the structure gate flipped bullish between 01:26 and 02:16 while the price line is still un-reclaimed. Add CONFLUENCE-GATE 26 blocks (single-type not in standalone bypass), RR-ENGINE 5, VOL-GATE-BYPASS 17.

New-risk direction, condition-locked: shorts remain favored WHILE BTC 1m holds below EMA300 ~81015 (re-verified at write time 02:19:58 — 80855 vs 81015, -0.20%, below 992 consecutive min) — age=3 cycles unexecuted. The margin narrowed from -0.22% to -0.20% and every structural source now leans bull, so this steer is close to invalidation: RETRACT it on a 1m close hold above EMA300 for 15-30m. Note the pipeline's LONG trend filter already enforces the identical condition — all six LONG prechecks failed "BTC ema300=BELOW" — so no separate manual action is required; the steer only matters for a manual entry.

Steer re-verification: automated steer-001 (disable volume-buildup-) is RETRACTED. Its four losses (ALT, CC, ME, ZRO) closed 11:46-14:54 Oct 23; re-reading the condition at 02:15 shows no new loss since — five straight profit-monster-trail wins followed (WLD, ICP, DYDX, MON, SYRUP) totaling +0.47, and the 20-trade window is 70% WR +0.39. Disabling now would strand our best recent short signal.

AI pick: NONE written this cycle. Every LONG candidate is blocked by the BTC-below-EMA300 trend filter (GMX, INJ, BIGTIME, WCT, YGG, HYPER all failed), and every SHORT that clears hard gates either sits in the 45-55 RSI death zone (RESOLV 50.5, PUMP 52.2) or fights an active LONG_BIAS pump (JUP: regime LONG_BIAS conf 89.8, +1.59% over 16 candles). Forcing either would knowingly pick a losing band. The standing APT SHORT entry (01:16) no longer passes — 1m RSI 44.2 is below the 45 floor and the unclog waiver expired 2026-10-24 — treat it as EXPIRED, not actionable. AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False anyway, so any pick would be watchlist-only.

Sideways fix applied: trade_watchdog.py collect_pipeline_status reported running=false because it aged a lock file that flock never touches (mtime frozen 2026-10-18). It now also treats pipeline.log freshness (<5 min) as liveness — pipeline.log was fresh at 02:21 while the flag read false. Display-only; nothing traded on it.
regime_context:
Sources disagree; each named with timestamp.

Continuum (02:19:58): BTC BELOW EMA300 — 80855.5 vs 81014.6 (-0.20%), 992 consecutive minutes (~16.5h) since 17:38 Oct 23 — while linreg_direction LEAN_BULL, market_phase RECOVERY, trend_quality UP, zscore_tier POS: a short-horizon recovery inside an un-reclaimed macro line.
5m aggregate scanner (02:15:02): LONG_BIAS (76 long / 5 short / 48 neutral); BTC 15m LONG_BIAS conf 61.7 slope +0.024. At 02:00 BTC 15m was NEUTRAL conf 52.7 and at 01:15 it was SHORT_BIAS conf 90.5 — a "strong short" decayed to neutral to long-bias in 60 minutes.
15m regime log (02:00): aggregate LONG_BIAS, BTC NEUTRAL.
Auto-trader (02:14): CHOP, scores long -25 / short -15, decision BRACKET, both sides armed (short trigger 80522.22, long trigger 81537.38).
Pipeline gates (02:16-02:17): CONTINUUM-BULL denying SHORTs "bullish structure"; the same gate denied LONGs "bearish structure" until 01:26.

Flip-rate KPI: aggregate 30 flips/24h, BTC 15m 18 flips/24h (96 dumps). 30 >= p95(26) = UNUSUALLY UNSTABLE tape (baseline p50 ~20-22; <6 — the real trend-tape reading, cheap for directional prose — last seen Oct 2). Report flips/24h alongside any directional steer and re-test the condition each cycle; the ≥6 line is vestigial and is not a finding.

Net: price-line bearish, structure bullish, aggregate long, auto-trader chop — four sources, three answers, which is why all direction prose here is condition-locked to the EMA300 test. New risk stays short-side or absent WHILE BTC 1m holds below EMA300 ~81015 (re-verified 02:19:58). Longs require either a 1m reclaim held 15-30m (the pipeline's trend filter detects it automatically) or hard momentum evidence above RSI 70 — midband longs are our measured bleed. Volatility LOW, volume LOW, phase CALM/RECOVERY: range conditions where the 14d record says entries lose and only trades whose trail arms get paid. Audit #110 verdicts unchanged and honored: no long-family block on 7d samples, waiver gate #102 live since 00:00Z.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED in PostgreSQL (brain) at 02:15. RSI from (_signal_metadata::json->>'rsi_14') per DRIFT-E. Windows: 24h n=22, 7d n=120, 14d n=344. Significance tested (scipy two-proportion z) — non-significant results are marked as such and NOT proposed as patterns.

1. TRAIL-ARMING IS THE LOSS MECHANISM (dominant, 14d, p<1e-4). trailing_activated=True n139: 78.4% WR, +9.86 vs False n205: 7.3% WR, -14.67 (z=13.48). Exit families 14d: hard_max_loss n77 -7.70 0% WR, atr_sl_hit n83 -5.96 1.2%, trail_arm_timeout n18 -0.60 22%, hard_sl n11 -0.82 0% vs profit-monster-trail n85 +5.08 89.4% and atr_trail_hit n26 +4.13 76.9%. 205 of 344 trades (60%) never armed. WINNING SIDE: any trade whose trail actually arms. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: not entry selection — the candle-vs-poll arming gap, already scoped as escalation #17 (candle-aware arming fix). This is an execution fix; do not re-propose exit-ladder or signal-parameter changes for it.

2. LONG-side bleed (STANDING steer, condition-locked, age=3 cycles). 7d: LONG n82 -1.73 37.8% vs SHORT n38 +0.56 44.7%. 24h: LONG n9 -0.24 33.3% vs SHORT n13 +0.31 61.5%. Independent confirmation — auto-trader shadow: longs 0/4 -0.11, shorts 3/4 +0.12. WINNING SIDE: short. WHY THE MIX IS LONG-HEAVY: signal inventory generates ~2x more longs than shorts regardless of tape (7d 82 vs 38), so the inventory picks our side, not the tape. LIMITS (Audit #110, honored): wrong-side attribution was refuted as an explanation of closed losses (24h autopsy p=0.116) and any long-family BLOCK on 7d samples was rejected (pump-chain+ 30d n76 +1.79). This is a tilt on new risk, not a gate.

3. RSI BANDS — what does NOT survive testing. The 7d "LONG 65+ wins" reading is an artifact: 14d LONG 45-65 n115 35.7% -3.33 vs LONG 65+ n63 34.9% +0.05, z p=0.92 — no difference; do not trade high-RSI longs as an edge. Directional only, NOT established: SHORT 45-55 n26 15.4% -1.21 vs SHORT 55-65 n12 41.7% +0.32 (z p=0.076). The death-zone read is corroborated by the live SHORT-MIDBAND gate (14d 9T 0W -0.89) but n=12/26 is too small to claim. WINNING SIDE for shorts = outside 45-55; we took 26 in-band shorts in 14d.

4. steer-001 (disable volume-buildup-) — RETRACTED, condition re-read at 02:15. The four flagged losses (ALT, CC, ME, ZRO) closed 11:46-14:54 Oct 23; no new loss since, five consecutive profit-monster-trail wins +0.47 (WLD, ICP, DYDX, MON, SYRUP). Window now 20T 70% +0.39. Do not disable. Re-trigger: any new volume-buildup- loss restarts the streak.

5. 24h bottom line: rolling 24h 22T 11W 50% +0.07; UTC days Oct 22 +0.34 (5T 80%) and Oct 23 +0.12 (22T 50%) both green — 7d still 120T 40% -1.17. Worst 7d signals by dollar: pump-chain+ n13 7.7% -0.89, bb-bounce-v2-long+ n17 47.1% -0.58 (losers outsize winners at near-50% WR), ai-trader-pending n14 14.3% -0.30, pump-chain- n35 22.9% -0.30. WINNING SIDE on exits, not signals: continuum-trend+ n5 80% +0.09 and every trail-family exit.
